caption: This five-step vetting flow helps you trust AI outputs. Save it as a repeatable workflow. What's the first claim you would verify in your next AI draft? #AI #Productivity #DecisionMaking #naelbuildingbig

slides.title: Your AI checks miss errors
slides.body: The concrete problem: AI outputs look solid but hide errors, sources, and biases. Here are five prompts to vet and fix AI-generated work.

slides.title: 1. Quick accuracy check
slides.body: Task: list factual claims, verdict (True/False/Unverified), and one source per claim. Output format: bullet list. Placeholder: {AI_OUTPUT}.

slides.title: 2. Source verification
slides.body: Task: verify each cited source; provide link, summary credibility, and flag missing references. Output: list grouped by claim. Placeholder: {CITATIONS}.

slides.title: 3. Fact-check deltas
slides.body: Task: extract numerical figures; compare to a trusted dataset; report delta, source, and confidence level. Placeholder: {DATASET}.

slides.title: 4. Clarity and bias check
slides.body: Task: identify ambiguous or biased language; suggest two clarifications and one counter-bias rewrite. Output: bullet list. Placeholder: {TEXT}.

slides.title: 5. Final vetting workflow
slides.body: Task: combine all checks; output final verdict, one-paragraph summary, and a checklist to reuse. Placeholder: {SYNTHESIS}.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Use this five-step vetting workflow to make AI-generated work reliable and decision-ready.
